hints.title: Level-Ordered Removal
hints.text: Generate candidate strings by removing single parentheses layer by layer until valid parenthesized strings are discovered.

hints.title: Stopping Search at First Valid Depth
hints.text: Once any valid string is found at the current removal distance, do not explore further removal depths.

hints.title: Breadth-First String Deduplication
hints.text: Initialize queue with s and a visited set. While queue is non-empty, check all strings in the current level. If any are valid parentheses, add to result and set found flag to true. If found, continue to finish current level and return results.

complexity.notes: Optimal level-order BFS finding minimum removals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^N subsets without level ordering tests redundant deeper removals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: BFS with visited deduplication guarantees minimal character removals.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Terminate search once the first valid removal depth is reached.
